title: A Playlist for the Yearbook
author: Astrid Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Joubert, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
